policy.promotion_rule: Only track a candidate after it has a concrete Newma stage caller, a reviewed SKILL.md, no generated media/cache files, and an upstream or origin note.
policy.bulk_vendor_rule: Do not bulk-add downloaded third-party skills into this repository.
